description: Points d'eau - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Pendant la canicule, voici les points d'eau où il est possible de se rafraichir. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Espaces Verts/Environnement, Réseaux/Energie. Its keywords are brumisateur, jet d'eau, jeu. The portal shows 89 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
